Sortering_en.Recycling centre: Take the garden hose to the recycling centre for landfill; do not put it in the plastics bin.

Sortering_en.Hazardous waste: Take it to a recycling centre in a sealed container labelled frying oil. A small sealed container may also go in the hazardous-waste box; not in food waste.

Sortering.Restaffald: Et fryse- eller køleelement sorteres som restaffald.

Sortering_en.Residual waste: Sort a freezer or cooling pack as residual waste.

Sortering_en.Residual waste: Follow the sorting label: soft plastic goes in the plastics bin; mixed-material bags go in residual waste.

Sortering_en.Residual waste: Put empty medicine blister packs in residual waste. If medicine remains, take them to a pharmacy.

Sortering_en.Recycling centre: Pack mineral wool in strong, transparent plastic bags before taking it to the insulation area at a recycling centre.

Sortering_en.Recycling centre: Book Silkeborg Forsyning’s special big bag and collection. A small amount of up to about 40 kg may be delivered once a year to a recycling centre, sealed in at least two layers of plastic; ask the staff.
